fusions.name: Flicker of Teeth
fusions.desc: Snaps a bolt of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet and a 20% chance to turn it against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Grin Before the Lunge
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 30 damage and always lands as a critical hit. It leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Blunted], its critical hit chance lowered, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Doubled-Back Trail
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Bait Taken
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
